desc: The Q5 Match is superior performance taken to the next level through heightened functionality and a relentless determination to deliver precisely what the experienced shooter demands. This platform allows you to maximize the accuracy, power, and speed necessary to dominate the competition completely. The slide is outfitted with features previously found only on custom handguns. It is ported and optic ready, with LPA sights as well as front and rear serrations. Walther's superior accuracy is quickly realized when shooting thanks to the 5" barrel with polygonal rifling and stepped chamber. The interchangeable backstraps allow you to tune your grip, giving you a perfect, straight-back trigger pull.
